= Creusot live identity fixture

One actual contract, no trusted axioms. This is a test input, not a claim that
proof has completed. The live workflow must separately establish installation,
false-control rejection, true-control proof and this identity obligation.

`why3find.json` follows Creusot v0.14.0's root configuration at upstream commit
`65349025c67e69fcd7479f1f420fa5904f69bc27`, narrowed to the installed Z3 prover
and without machine-specific timing profiles. The installed Creusot package
supplies the prelude; the project configuration alone does not supply a solver.

`Cargo.lock` must be generated by Cargo, committed and checked with `--locked`;
never manufacture package versions or checksums. Build/proof outputs are ignored.
